actual: The request preparer produces a v2 daily-envelope request, but the Windows-to-WSL training and calibration launchers do not expose or forward --contract. The WSL entrypoints therefore retain their legacy-v1 default and route the v2 request into the v1 pipeline. Formal training fails before data projection with schema_version, label_policy_version, and entry_gap_condition validation errors; calibration would fail by the same missing-forwarding path.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: After PR #4704, both Windows-to-WSL price-range launchers omit the explicit contract selector already supported by their WSL entrypoints. Add a backward-compatible --contract option to each launcher, forward it unchanged, and cover both paths with direct tests. Do not change QE public code or experiment semantics.
expected: Selecting daily-envelope-v1 at the Windows launcher must forward that exact contract to the WSL entrypoint, while omission must preserve the legacy-v1 compatibility default.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
title: Daily price envelope WSL launcher routes v2 request into legacy pipeline
